visualCharacteristics: Large 4x3 image about 55% left, headline + description + red uppercase CTA right, vertically centred

cells: H2 headline link, description paragraph, CTA link
contentPattern.structure: two cells: the image alone, then an H2 headline (optionally linked), a description and a final paragraph holding only the CTA link. With the Wide option, a paragraph before the H2 is a kicker label and the description/CTA may be left out

usage.description: Editorial promo that pairs a large image with a headline, short description and an uppercase call-to-action link, e.g. '30-Minute Dinners' or 'Our Recipe Testing and Editing Process'.

reuseGuidance: Use for a single featured promo between card grids. Put the image alone in the first cell; put the H2 headline (optionally linked), description and a final paragraph containing only the CTA link in the second cell.
